meetings.title: Kickoff call
meetings.transcript:
Sam (RouteIQ): Thanks for joining. Priya, what does success look like for Northwind?
Priya Nair (Northwind, VP Ops): Honestly, the number one thing is the Salesforce CRM integration. My dispatchers need to see a customer's full history the moment a call comes in. Without that, we can't go live.
Daniel Reyes (Northwind, IT Director): For me it's single sign-on with our Okta setup. Security will block us otherwise.
Maya Chen (RouteIQ, PM): Understood. CRM integration and SSO both make sense as launch requirements.
Sam (RouteIQ): On pricing, we quoted 48,000 dollars a year for 100 seats.
Priya Nair: That's in the ballpark. Maya, can you send us the integration roadmap?
Maya Chen: Yes, I'll share the roadmap by July 28.

meetings.title: Roadmap review
meetings.transcript:
Maya Chen (RouteIQ, PM): Here's the plan. Salesforce CRM integration lands in October, SSO in September.
Priya Nair (Northwind, VP Ops): October works, but I want to be clear, CRM is a must-have before go-live.
Arjun Rao (RouteIQ, Engineering Lead): I'll have a CRM sandbox demo ready for you by August 25 so you can see it early.
Daniel Reyes (Northwind, IT Director): Another concern from my side. Where will our data be stored? We have data residency rules and I haven't had an answer yet.
Sam (RouteIQ): We'll come back to you on that.
Priya Nair: On price, if we sign for two years, can you do 42,000 a year?
Sam (RouteIQ): Let me take that back to the team.

meetings.title: Internal product sync
meetings.transcript:
Maya Chen (RouteIQ, PM): Leadership decided to pull the analytics dashboard into Q4. A competitor just launched one and we're losing deals over it.
Arjun Rao (RouteIQ, Engineering): That means the Salesforce CRM integration moves to Q1 next year. We don't have the people for both.
Sam (RouteIQ): Should we tell Northwind? They were told October.
Maya Chen: Let's hold off until the analytics beta is ready, we'll bundle the message.
Arjun Rao: Also the CRM sandbox demo I promised for August 25 will probably slip.
Maya Chen: Fine. Analytics dashboard beta goes live in October, that's the decision.

meetings.title: Client check-in
meetings.transcript:
Sam (RouteIQ): Good news, we're launching an analytics dashboard beta in October and you'll get early access.
Priya Nair (Northwind, VP Ops): Nice, analytics is useful. As long as the CRM integration still lands this year, we're happy.
Sam (RouteIQ): We're working hard on everything.
Daniel Reyes (Northwind, IT Director): Arjun promised a CRM sandbox demo today. Where is it?
Arjun Rao (RouteIQ, Engineering): We'll need to reschedule that one.
Daniel Reyes: And I still have no answer on data residency.
Sam (RouteIQ): On pricing, we can offer 44,000 a year on a two-year term.
Priya Nair: That works for us, send it in writing.

meetings.title: Internal account review
meetings.transcript:
Sam (RouteIQ): Northwind opened two support tickets about SSO login failures last week.
Maya Chen (RouteIQ, PM): Engineering says SSO fixes ship September 30. CRM integration is still Q1.
Jordan Blake (RouteIQ, Finance): Heads up, I can't approve 44,000. Our floor for a two-year deal is 46,000 a year.
Sam (RouteIQ): I already verbally offered 44,000 to Priya.
Jordan Blake: Then we have a problem. Let's sort it before the business review.
Maya Chen: Agreed. Also we still owe Daniel the data residency answer.
